# FunkYouSHiFT

Official site: https://www.funkyoushift.com/

FunkYouSHiFT is a Borderlands creator/community hub for Discord, trading, modded gear discussion, giveaways, embedded content, merch, and useful Borderlands resources.

## Important pages
- Home: https://www.funkyoushift.com/
- Discord/community: https://www.funkyoushift.com/discord.html
- Borderlands modding help: https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-modding.html
- Borderlands trading help: https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-trading.html
- Borderlands resources: https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-resources.html
- Borderlands build video resources: https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-build-videos.html
- Merch: https://www.funkyoushift.com/merch.html
- Gallery: https://www.funkyoushift.com/gallery.html
- Giveaways: https://www.funkyoushift.com/giveaway.html
- Donate/support: https://www.funkyoushift.com/donate.html

## External resources referenced
- Lootlemon: https://www.lootlemon.com/
- BL4Hunt: https://www.bl4hunt.com/
- Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/funkyoushift
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@funkyoushift
- Streamlabs merch: https://streamlabs.com/funkyoushift/merch

## Site direction
The site should route visitors quickly to Discord, merch, content, socials, and helpful Borderlands resource pages. Tone should stay direct, helpful, and FunkYouSHiFT-branded rather than corporate.
